name: 香槟金瓶水感精华液款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, soft lilac #DCD3F0 and blush pink #F6D9DE pastel fields with rounded podium props for info, scene and closing shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio light, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pastel podium discs and frosted glass-look panels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and slim-stroke molecule spheres in champagne gold #D2A96E only
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the bottle across the set, centered and upright
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dreamy pastel skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, soft lilac #DCD3F0, blush pink #F6D9DE, deep violet-grey text #4E4666 and one champagne gold accent #D2A96E; bright soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line icons and slim-stroke molecule spheres in champagne gold only; clean high-end serum photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bottle upright and centered, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view, the bottle standing upright and centered, full product visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. 2K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background tint, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1香槟金盖双瓶精华液粉紫梦幻展台主视觉，紫字标题与粉色角标（原文案剥离）；屏2紫底金色精华滴落卖点图，四周白圈卖点词与副题（原文案剥离）；屏3三个空白图框加紫色按钮为模板残留，下半为植物成分列表与瓶身金分子球环绕；屏4白底瓶身配分子球与安全类圈词、品牌行与编号卖点列表（功效断言全部剥离）；屏5紫底编号卖点、金色横幅与专利类字样（剥离，不写入）；屏6紫底四圆关键词与底部粉紫展台场景；屏7展台场景加参数表（真空度、转速、功率类仪器数值，与精华液自相矛盾的模板残留，不采信）；屏8产品信息表品名写面霜、规格写面膜尺寸与片数、另一处写克重，互相矛盾均不采信，另有会员角标、二维码与素材站水印（剥离）。品类判定：全部主视觉与标题均为精华液，瓶型为泵头精华瓶，使用部位为面部，判护肤个护/面部护理而非洗护发；参数区品名与规格为模板残留不改判。已剥离：品牌英文字与系列名、原文案原句、功效与专利类字样、检测与注册编号空栏、会员角标、二维码、素材站水印；产品一律以 {product} 占位。
